AddOn.Name: Strike
AddOn.Text:
For 1 turn/ grants 100% accuracy rate.
Effect is overridden by Alert.

AddOn.Name: Attune
AddOn.Text: Grants target ally the effects of Strike.

AddOn.Name: Alert
AddOn.Text:
Grants 100% chance to dodge the next attack.
Overrides Strike/ but ineffective against Support Attacks.

AddOn.Name: Assault
AddOn.Text: Grants the effects of Accel/ Strike/ and Valor.

AddOn.Name: Confuse
AddOn.Text:
For 1 turn/ all enemies will have their accuracy rates halved.
Effect overriden by Strike.

AddOn.Name: Miracle
AddOn.Text:
Grants the effects of Accel/ Strike/ Alert/ Drive/ Valor/ Guard/
Luck/ Gain/ and Guts.
